name: WF-247 — Reconciled Closing Evidence → Final Closing Outcome & Completion Controller

parameters.jsCode: const d=$json.body??$json;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const reconciliation_status=String(d.reconciliation_status??d.status??"").toLowerCase();const required=Array.isArray(d.required_evidence)?d.required_evidence:[];const verified=Array.isArray(d.verified_evidence)?d.verified_evidence:[];const milestones=Array.isArray(d.milestones)?d.milestones:[];const blockers=Array.isArray(d.blockers)?d.blockers:[];const execution_identity=String(d.execution_identity??d.signature_id??"").trim();const signed_evidence=Boolean(d.signed_evidence??d.executed_agreement??false);const missing=required.map(x=>typeof x==="string"?x:String(x?.key??x?.type??"")).filter(Boolean).filter(k=>!new Set(verified.map(x=>typeof x==="string"?x:String(x?.key??x?.type??"")).filter(Boolean)).has(k));const incomplete=milestones.filter(m=>m&&m.status!=="completed");let status="needs_review",reason="Final closing outcome requires review.",next="WF-126";if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id){status="blocked";reason="Missing lead, deal, or property identity.";}else if(blockers.length){status="blocked";reason="Unresolved closing blockers remain.";}else if(reconciliation_status!=="reconciled"){status="evidence_reconciliation_incomplete";reason="Closing evidence has not been fully reconciled.";next="WF-246";}else if(missing.length){status="evidence_incomplete";reason="Required closing evidence remains missing: "+missing.join(", ")+ ".";next="WF-246";}else if(incomplete.length){status="completion_incomplete";reason="Closing milestones remain incomplete.";next="WF-245";}else if(!execution_identity||!signed_evidence){status="execution_evidence_missing";reason="Executed agreement/signature evidence is not sufficiently confirmed.";next="WF-242";}else{status="closing_outcome_ready";reason="Closing evidence, execution identity, and milestones are reconciled; final close verification may proceed.";next="WF-248";}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-247",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,reconciliation_status,missing_evidence:missing,incomplete_milestones:incomplete,execution_identity,signed_evidence,final_outcome_status:status,reason,requires_human_review:status!=="closing_outcome_ready",next_workflow:next}}];
